text:
sasha: Heads up — Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC we're moving audit-shipper traffic off the central bastion and through a VPC proxy (privnet). This requires: IAM delegation for the audit-proxy role, a KMS key policy change to allow proxy decrypts, and a firewall rule to open 10.5.100.0/24 -> s3-logs. This will briefly affect EU GPU pool onboarding. Please review and shout if concerns.

lex: Can you drop the exact IAM/KMS changes and the rollback plan?

sasha: IAM/KMS snippet below. Rollback = revert policy + repoint shipper to central bastion. We expect transient decrypt errors during the flip, ~3-5m.

sasha: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-proxy"},
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
    }
  ]
}
```

irene: :eyes: Are we changing S3 retention for shipper logs? Last proxy test showed a ~30% logging cost bump.

sasha: Propose temporary retention trim to 30d for the EU shipper bucket during migration. Restore to 90d after 72h if no regressions. This should cut the spike and keeps enough data for audits.

sam: ops-oncall FYI — expect ~3-5m of KMS decrypt errors and retries from onboarding agents. We have an automated fallback to old path if error rate > 5%.

ops-oncall: Roger. I'll watch error-rate and page if >2%. Please add an explicit line in the playbook for GPU node onboarding stalls.

audit-bot: NOTE: Audit config change detected. New role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-proxy scheduled 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z.

lex: Approved from platform side. Can we run a 5% traffic canary in the prod region before full flip?

sasha: Yes — canaries scheduled at 02:00 and 02:15 UTC. Will post canary health here (kms/sec, 5xxs, onboarding stalls).

sam: Also tagging finance for visibility on retention change: @finance please eyeball the temporary cost delta.

sasha: Posted runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/vpc-proxy-migration — includes rollback commands and the quick checklist.

irene: If canary looks green, green to proceed on full migration at 02:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

sasha: Understood. I'll update this thread after each canary step. End of thread.
